topic: 无本体 ego-centric 数据中，手部检测/追踪精度如何影响重定向后机器人本体末端轨迹的精度与可用性？误差来源、传播路径、可接受阈值与缓解手段是什么？

paper.title: CDF-Glove: A Cable-Driven Force Feedback Glove for Dexterous Teleoperation

claim: CDF-Glove 的绳驱-编码器手部关节传感在食指 DIP 关节重复定位实验中达到标准差 <0.4°（3 次重复：接触角均值 63.15°、标准差 0.29°），作者称 MCP/PIP 关节同类测试标准差同样低于 0.4°，表明其手部追踪一致性在亚度量级。

evidence.summary: V.A.3 逐字报告 DIP 三次重复的均值/标准差与 <0.4° 结论，并声称 MCP/PIP 同类结果。
evidence.short_quote: This process repeats three times. We calculate the mean and standard deviation of the contact angle, resulting in an average value of 63.15°, with standard deviations of 0.29°, respectively. As shown in Fig. 9, the standard deviation of repeated positioning for the index finger distal joint (DIP) using CDF-Glove is less than 0.4°, indicating high accuracy and stability.

core_citations.reference: [23] Y. Park, J. Lee, and J. Bae. Development of a wearable sensing glove for measuring the motion of fingers using linear potentiometers and flexible wires. IEEE TII 11(1), 2015.
core_citations.reason: PIP-DIP 耦合经验公式 (2) 的常数来源，PIP 被动推算的误差根源可追溯到该外部位标定。

notes: 对综述问题的定位：本批次中唯一的手套式直接传感路线，与视觉追踪路线形成原理级对照。核心价值：(1) 提供稀缺的传感层定量参照（重复性 <0.4° std、力反馈延迟 200ms 及准静态边界）；(2) limitation 自证手套路线并非无误差——漂移/零偏/PCB 延迟是传感原理特异性误差来源。注意红线：0.4° 是重复性不是绝对精度，下游 +55pp 混淆了触觉闭环与传感保真度两个因素。ID 预算限制：下游 DP-vs-KT 证据留于 findings/tables 未单独成卡。

paper_reading.relation: 支持『可接受阈值』问题的一个参照点：手套式直接传感的关节角重复性可达亚度量级（<0.4° std），为视觉追踪路线提供传感保真度的对照基准——但注意这是一致性（repeatability）而非绝对精度。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字匹配 V.A.3；数值 63.15°/0.29°/<0.4° 与原文一致；claim 明确将指标定性为重复性/一致性（亚度量级），并指出 MCP/PIP 仅为作者口头声称，未夸大为绝对精度。

quantitative.metric: repeated positioning standard deviation 重复定位标准差（contact angle 接触角）
quantitative.value_or_direction: mean 63.15°, std 0.29°; DIP <0.4°, MCP/PIP 同样 below 0.4°
quantitative.comparator: zero-position reset baseline 零位复位基准（3 repeated trials 三次重复）
quantitative.task_or_sample: index finger DIP reset-flex-return repeated positioning, 3 trials; similar tests on MCP/PIP of index and middle fingers

paper.title: CDF-Glove: A Cable-Driven Force Feedback Glove for Dexterous Teleoperation

claim: CDF-Glove 的绳驱力反馈响应时间约 200ms，作者将其归因于 RS485 串行通信瓶颈与绳驱伺服的机械响应时间，并明确划定可接受边界：该延迟对高速交互偏高，但对数据集内的准静态操作任务是足够的。

evidence.summary: V.A.2 逐字给出 200ms 测量值、RS485+伺服的归因与『高速偏高/准静态足够』的边界陈述。
evidence.short_quote: The experimental results indicate that the response time for cable-driven force feedback, based on current information from the RY-H1, is nearly 200 ms. The 200 ms force-feedback latency is primarily attributed to the serial communication bottleneck (RS485) and the mechanical response time of the cable-driven servos. While relatively high for high-speed interactions, it proved sufficient for the quasi-static manipulation tasks in our datasets.

paper_reading.relation: 条件性回答『可接受阈值』：触觉闭环遥操作中 ~200ms 的反馈延迟在准静态任务下被任务成功所容忍，高速交互则越界——给出延迟阈值的任务依赖性判据（准静态可行/高速不可行），而非通用数字。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字匹配 V.A.2；200ms、RS485 瓶颈归因与准静态/高速边界均为作者原文；claim 保留『对高速偏高』的自限，未将 200ms 表述为通用可接受值。

quantitative.comparator: quasi-static tasks tolerated vs high-speed interactions excessive 准静态可容忍 vs 高速交互偏高
quantitative.task_or_sample: RY-H1 index finger rigid-sphere contact, current-based feedback triggering (Fig. 10)

paper.title: CDF-Glove: A Cable-Driven Force Feedback Glove for Dexterous Teleoperation

claim: CDF-Glove 作者明确承认其手部传感链存在编码器信号漂移与零偏波动、PCB 引起的控制延迟等误差来源，并将『集成绳驱控制策略以进一步降低追踪误差』列为在途工作——即手套式直接传感的追踪误差并未被消除，而是以漂移/零偏/延迟形态持续存在。

evidence.summary: VI 章 limitation 段逐字列出编码器信号漂移、零偏波动、PCB 控制延迟，并给出以降低追踪误差为目标的后续工作。
evidence.short_quote: Current limitations include restricted force output, lack of complex haptic feed- back, encoder signal drift and zero-offset fluctuation, as well as PCB-induced control latency. Ongoing work will focus on enhancing the force output, optimizing the PCB design to minimize latency, and integrating cable-driven control strategies [25] to further reduce tracking errors.

paper_reading.relation: 限定『手套直接传感可规避视觉追踪误差』的推定：传感路线从视觉换为编码器后，误差来源并未消失而是换为漂移、零偏、控制延迟等形态；误差来源枚举应覆盖传感原理特异性误差。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 引文逐字匹配 VI 章（feed- back 断词按原文保留）；漂移/零偏/PCB 延迟三项与『降低追踪误差』的在途工作均出自该段；claim 未给出漂移幅度等原文没有的量化。
